categories.main_business_segments: Madison Square Garden Sports Corp. (MSGS) operates a single business segment focused on owning and operating professional sports franchises. Its primary assets are the New York Knicks (NBA), New York Rangers (NHL), and their respective development league affiliates: the Westchester Knicks (NBA G League) and Hartford Wolf Pack (AHL). The company also previously owned an esports franchise and operates a professional sports training center.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: MSGS's core operations revolve around the management and development of professional sports teams, leveraging advanced training facilities, analytics, and player development systems. The company utilizes state-of-the-art performance centers and technology-driven approaches for athlete training, injury rehabilitation, and team operations, as well as dynamic ticket pricing and digital fan engagement platforms.
categories.primary_customers_markets: The primary customers are sports fans, corporate clients, and media partners. MSGS serves a broad demographic of basketball and hockey fans, with a strong focus on the New York metropolitan area, the largest U.S. media market. Corporate customers are targeted through suite and sponsorship sales, while media partners include regional and national broadcasters.
categories.geographic_coverage: MSGS's operations and revenues are almost entirely concentrated in the United States, specifically in the New York City metropolitan area. The Knicks and Rangers play home games at Madison Square Garden in Manhattan, and the company’s influence is strongest in the tri-state area, though its teams have national and international fan bases.
categories.supply_chain_position: MSGS operates at the downstream end of the sports and entertainment supply chain, directly engaging with end consumers (fans), corporate sponsors, and media distributors. The company is responsible for the final delivery of live sports entertainment and related experiences.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The company’s strategy centers on developing championship-caliber teams, maximizing the value of exclusive live sports content, and enhancing the fan experience. MSGS invests in player development, analytics, and training infrastructure, and pursues integrated sponsorship and media partnerships. Innovation is focused on ticketing, digital engagement, and leveraging its iconic brands for long-term value creation.
categories.revenue_model: MSGS generates revenue through multiple streams: ticket sales (season, group, and single-game), suite and premium club licenses, sponsorships and signage, local and national media rights, food and beverage sales, and merchandise. Many revenue streams are secured through multi-year contracts, providing recurring income.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: MSGS competes with other major New York sports franchises (Yankees, Mets, Giants, Jets, Islanders, Devils, Nets, NYCFC, Red Bulls) and a wide range of entertainment options in the region. Within the NBA and NHL, it competes for talent, fans, and media attention. The Knicks and Rangers are among the most recognized and valuable franchises in their leagues, benefiting from their storied histories and large fan bases.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: For the fiscal year ended June 30, 2023, MSGS reported revenues of $887 million, with an 8% year-over-year increase. The company had operating income of $85 million and net income attributable to stockholders of $48 million. MSGS has a market capitalization of approximately $3.4 billion and maintains significant liquidity and borrowing capacity, with revenues and cash flows concentrated in the second and third fiscal quarters due to the sports seasonality.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: MSGS offers fans access to iconic, championship-aspiring teams in the nation’s largest media market, delivering premium live sports experiences at Madison Square Garden. Its unique value lies in the strength of its brands, deep fan loyalty, integrated sponsorship and hospitality offerings, and exclusive media content, all underpinned by a commitment to first-class operations and innovation in fan engagement.
